		GRE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_pending_ENG
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_live_ENG
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_negotiating_ENG }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_option_defer_a_decision
		ai_chance = { factor = 10 }
		trigger = {
			GRE = { exists = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_pending_ENG has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_live_ENG
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_4
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_security_state }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_restricted_public_life }
			}
		}
		GRE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_pending_ENG
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_live_ENG
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_deferred_ENG }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_option_close_an_obsolete_proposal
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		trigger = {
			NOT = { GRE = { exists = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_pending_ENG has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_6_live_ENG
			original_tag = GRE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_foreign_4
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_security_state }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_GRE_1970_restricted_public_life }
			} }
		}
	}
}
